s1.text:
The corridor narrows. Iron bars line every wall, remnants of a prison that never released its dead. Somewhere ahead, metal scrapes against stone — a guard's blade, dragged lazily along the floor.

Two paths diverge: a dark crawlspace to the left where the bars have rusted through, and the main gate straight ahead — guarded.
s1.ascensionText: You've been here before. The iron bars are the same, but now you notice the notches — tally marks from prisoners who never left. The air feels thicker, like the corridor knows you're back.
s1.imagePrompt: A narrow prison corridor with iron bars on every wall, dim torchlight, a dark crawlspace on the left, a guarded gate ahead, oppressive atmosphere, dark fantasy

choices.text: Study the lock mechanism on the gate

s2a.text:
You slip through unnoticed, emerging in a narrow passage behind the Warden's chamber. Through a crack in the wall, you can see him — pacing, muttering to himself about discipline and order.

His armor has a weak point: the left pauldron doesn't sit flush. It shifts when he turns.
s2a.imagePrompt: A crack in a stone wall revealing an armored warden pacing in a torchlit chamber, perspective from hiding, spy view, dark fantasy

choices.text: Look for something to exploit in the room
You know that armor flaw — standard issue, same weakness you were trained to exploit

s2b.text:
The rust gives way with a screech that echoes through the corridor. A guard rounds the corner, lantern raised.

You're caught between the bars and the blade. But you've been in tighter spots.
s2b.imagePrompt: A guard with a raised lantern rounding a corridor corner, alarmed expression, iron bars in foreground, tense moment, dark fantasy

choices.text: Bluff — act like you belong here

s2c.text:
The guard doesn't flinch as you approach. He's seen a hundred challengers. He steps aside without a word — respect, or indifference, you can't tell.

Beyond the gate, the Warden's domain opens up. Cold stone, strict geometry. Everything here obeys rules.
s2c.imagePrompt: A stern armored guard stepping aside at a prison gate, cold stone geometry beyond, strict military architecture, dark fantasy

choices.text: Study the layout — find tactical advantages
March straight to the arena — show no hesitation

s3.text:
The Warden's arena lies ahead. You can hear his voice — deep, measured, reciting rules to no one.

"Order. Discipline. Control." The words echo off iron walls.

A final choice before the fight.
s3.imagePrompt: An imposing arena entrance with iron walls, an armored warden's silhouette visible through steam and torchlight, intimidating presence, dark fantasy

choices.text: Center yourself — find calm before the storm
Stretch and loosen up — speed wins fights
Tear a bar from the wall — forge your own weapon from his prison

s4_final.text:
The iron gates grind open. The Warden turns to face you, his armor catching the torchlight. His eyes are cold, calculating.

"Rules exist for a reason," he says. "Let me show you why."
s4_final.ascensionText: The Warden doesn't turn this time. He's already facing you, arms crossed. "Back for another lesson?" His voice is harder now. "This time, I'll make sure it sticks."
s4_final.imagePrompt: A massive armored warden turning to face the viewer, cold calculating eyes visible through a helmet visor, iron arena, dramatic torchlight, dark fantasy boss encounter
